selection_time_basis: Implementation-session UTC; ordering frozen before generation and before any model outcome. Not a source-document creation time.
exposure: pinned baseline documentation, source, public tests
rule: Rank document units by target feature tag, then public-request common-contract tag, then fixed corpus path and byte start. Tags come from curated public headings/capabilities, not change-file locations. Stop at first whole unit exceeding budget; never skip or truncate.
